mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points within one month signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a severe contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy enters a slowdown phase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 2.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payroll employment and rises in unemployment rate signal a severe labor market collapse, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks surge.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth below 1.0% annualized signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
